purpose: Acquire and audit the pre-reserved PanCanAtlas merged HM27/HM450 DNA-methylation source without inspecting any methylation association with RNA, protein, genomic, clinical, treatment, or dynamical outcomes.

primary_source.publication_processing: HM27 and HM450 Level-3 beta values merged on shared probes; HM27 values probe-by-probe proportionally rescaled against HM450 technical replicates; probes with residual platform difference >=0.1 in at least six tumor types were excluded.
primary_source.representation: publication-era PanCanAtlas beta values on a 0-to-1 scale

matching.primary_key: TCGA sample root through vial, e.g. TCGA-XX-YYYY-01A
matching.fallback: patient-level match only when the methylation source contains exactly one eligible primary measurement for that patient

platform_rule.primary_representation: use the publication-era merged HM27/HM450 matrix as supplied
platform_rule.reason: preserve provenance and cohort-era comparability with the publication-freeze RNA, genomic, purity/leukocyte, and RPPA layers already used in Stages A-B2

stage_c1_required_architecture.modal: mode-resolved methylation structure and participation/eigenspectrum quantities
stage_c1_required_architecture.scalar: compressed coordinates only where separately justified and never labeled chi unless CHI_ADMISSION_RULES are satisfied
stage_c1_required_architecture.conglomeration: module-to-module and whole-system organization across independently defined layers
stage_c1_required_architecture.complementarity_rule: scalar summaries may not replace modal or conglomeration structure
